'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Jones LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Jones]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
